name: Elematic — Addons for Elementor
author: Anwar Hossain

sections.description:
Elematic is a super lightweight Elementor addon plugin offering a growing collection of hand-crafted widgets to supercharge your design workflow — without slowing down your site.

Whether you’re a designer, developer, or agency, Elematic delivers clean, flexible widgets for modern websites. Build interactive layouts, stunning headings, animated content, and more — with zero bloat.

🔥 Why Use Elematic?

  • Built for speed & performance (Hello Theme friendly)
  • Modern UI/UX with clean markup
  • Full compatibility with Elementor Free & Pro
  • SEO-friendly output & accessibility focus

🔧 Included Widgets

Here’s what you get with version 1.0:

  • Accordion – Toggle-style FAQs or content sections
  • Animated Heading – Dynamic headings with Typed or Morph animation
  • Animated Shape – Looping SVG/Blob animations for sections
  • Button – Stylish buttons with hover effects & icons
  • Circle Progress Bar – Animated circular progress with % counter
  • Circle Text – Rotating text effects around a center element
  • Grid – Responsive post or image grid layout
  • Highlight Text – Emphasize parts of a sentence with animated highlights
  • Image Animate – Zoom, float, and other image reveal effects
  • Image Slide – Sliding image reveals or hover transitions
  • Info Link – Tabbed content or image/text switcher with links
  • Lottie – Native Lottie animation widget with JSON support
  • Marquee – Scrolling text (horizontal ticker effect)
  • Service List – Clean list layout with icons/text for services

… and more on the way!

Credits

Developed by Anwar Hossain
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/elematic/ or install via Plugins > Add New
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress
  3. Open any Elementor page and start using “Elematic” widgets in the panel
sections.faq:
Does it work with Elementor Free?

Yes. All widgets are compatible with Elementor Free and do not require Pro.

Will it slow down my website?

No. Elematic is optimized for performance and includes only essential assets.

Can I use it with other Elementor addons?

Absolutely! Elematic is compatible with all major Elementor addon packs.

Does it support Lottie animations?

Yes. A dedicated Lottie widget is included.
